_comment: Copy to tools/roi.json and tune with `node tools/inspect.mjs <capture>`. All rects are [x, y, w, h] as FRACTIONS of the frame. These values were measured off the first real 1280x720 NSS captures (2026-08-20): two frame types exist. ADDRESS frames carry hole/par, stroke-or-distance badge, club name, wind; RESULT POPUP frames carry the landing lie title, distance-remaining line, and the power gauge still showing its fill (teal = filled, white outline = empty).

gauge._comment: Search window only — the bar TILTS with controller angle and shifts position between frames, so the reader must auto-locate the teal/outline column inside this window rather than assume a fixed rect. Quarter dots + orange top dot mark the 4 bars.

popupTitle._comment: Result popup lie title: Fairway / Green / Rough / Bunker... = the NEXT shot's lie.

popupDistance._comment: Result popup line like '93 yd to go' / '49.9 ft to go' (FEET on the green - divide by 3). Letters and digits both need templates; parse the leading number + unit.

windSpeed._comment: '6 mph' under the top-right wind circle on ADDRESS frames.

windArrow._comment: Top-right wind arrow circle on ADDRESS frames. 8 orientations -> template match (not implemented yet).

club._comment: Selected club name label (Driver/Spoon/...) bottom-right on ADDRESS frames.

holePar._comment: 'Hole 3  Par 5' banner top-left on ADDRESS frames.

strokeBadge._comment: Badge under the player name: alternates 'Stroke N' and 'NNN yd to go' on ADDRESS frames.
